methodology_3.cold: Fresh process and unique empty cache_httpfs directory per trial; no query warmup

methodology_3.excluded: Preflight, extension installation, result hashing, report writing, teardown

methodology_3.std: Sample standard deviation; undefined for one sample
methodology_3.cache_bytes: On-disk footprint after query; not measured network bytes
methodology_3.comparison: Require identical data, symbol, result hash, environment and extension binaries
